task.title: Command network transport isolation (reviewed candidate) + oversized read-model payload audit

result.summary: Part A: implemented the evidence-backed fix from the 9:38 AM connectivity diagnosis -- ProductionNativeAPI.submitCommand now runs through a separately-injectable commandTransport (default nil = shares the read transport, exact pre-existing behavior for every caller that doesn't opt in), and the real app wires in CommandNetworkDiagnosticsTransport.production(): its own dedicated URLSession (own connection pool, isolated from bulk reads), waitsForConnectivity, and a 60s timeoutIntervalForResource ceiling. Captures URLSessionTaskMetrics + NWPath on every command attempt via a new bounded CommandNetworkDiagnostics log. No control-flow change to auth/idempotency/retry. Ten new tests (including two against real network I/O), a genuine compile-time RED check, full regression (1463 unit + 13 UI tests), and an independent fresh-context review all passed clean. Pushed as 3b0ccbed. Part B: a zero-write, measured audit of the oversized read-model payloads found that dailyBriefings (16.3 MB) and analyses/confidence-records (27.4 MB) are fetched with zero date/count limit and drive Home/Goals; evidenceReviews (7.4 MB, 83% already status=confirmed) is fetched unbounded for Log/Morning-Check-In/Coaching-Updates-Detail with no status filter, a >99.9% reduction opportunity if filtered to pending-only. A concrete, prioritized reduction plan was written up -- nothing implemented, per instruction, since this is diagnosis and plan only.

tests.summary: Full PhysiqueOSTests target: 1463/1463 passing (1453 prior + 10 new). GoalsAcceptanceUITests 1/1, TrainingAcceptanceUITests 12/12 -- 13/13 UI tests passing, both after a clean build.

red_check.summary: Reverting only FounderServerAPI.swift's wiring broke the whole project's compile at AppEnvironment.swift's new commandTransport: argument (extra argument 'commandTransport' in call), proving the wiring is real and load-bearing. Restoring it passed clean again. Independently reproduced by the fresh-context review.

review.summary: Independent fresh-context review confirmed submitCommand's control flow is byte-identical apart from which transport it routes through, the nil-default fallback preserves every existing test unchanged, locking in NetworkPathObserver/MetricsCollectingDelegate is sound with no deadlock risk, URLSession retains its delegate for the task's full lifetime so it cannot be prematurely deallocated, connection-pool isolation is genuinely achieved (two independent URLSession instances -- one being .shared -- are guaranteed separate connection caches), and no unintended changes exist elsewhere. No blocking issues found; two theoretical, explicitly non-blocking observations noted.

payload_audit.summary: Zero-write, owner-scoped, ROLLBACK-guaranteed reads of physiqueos.canonical_* tables measured raw collection sizes for the Founder's account: analyses 27.35 MB (411 rows), dailyBriefings 16.31 MB (54 rows), evidenceReviews 7.39 MB (243 rows, 202 already status=confirmed), canonicalEvidenceObjects 2.52 MB (573 rows). Cross-referenced against CoreNavigationReadService.js's actual query predicates to confirm which are fetched with zero date/count/status limit. One open reconciliation gap noted explicitly: the measured figures are raw DB fetch bytes, not confirmed wire response size, since the deployed container has no importable raw source tree to run the actual composition functions against.

unexpected_findings: analysis_*_images records (training-evidence and goal-evaluation submission images) run 20-354 KB versus ~1.6 KB for a routine analysis record -- strongly suggesting image/binary data embedded directly in confidence-analysis JSONB rather than a media reference, the same class of problem this lane already fixed once for Completed Goal photos. Not confirmed this pass -- flagged for follow-up.

Summing the unbounded dailyBriefings+analyses fetch (~44 MB) exceeds the observed 4.7 MB max payloadBytes for Home, meaning the composed output likely projects only a slice of what it fetches server-side -- the primary proven cost right now is DB I/O/connection-hold-time rather than a confirmed equivalent wire-size reduction. Needs someone who can run the actual composition code to reconcile.
backlog: Recommended (not implemented): filter evidenceReviews to status=pending for Log/Morning-Check-In/Coaching-Updates-Detail -- measured 7.39 MB -> ~1.7 KB, the single most confidently-justified item in the audit.
Recommended (not implemented): bound dailyBriefings/analyses to a recent window for Home/Goals -- larger, cross-cutting change needing the composed-output reconciliation resolved first.
Recommended (not implemented): confirm whether analysis_*_images records embed raw image bytes; if so, migrate to a media-reference model.
goals.active.build-lean-mass's exact query construction was not traced this pass -- flagged as plausibly sharing the same unbounded-fetch pattern, unconfirmed.
Two ChatGPT master-thread-context handoffs remain unread in the inbox, staying scoped exactly to this task as instructed.

Separately, authorize and scope the Server-side evidenceReviews status filter (item 1 of the payload plan) as its own small, reviewable patch -- it is the clearest, lowest-risk win identified. Do not solicit another Strength attempt; let the next natural attempt validate the transport isolation fix.
